featureSupport.description: Feature support flags for this database version

activeActive.description: Indicates whether this version supports Active-Active (CRDB) databases

flex.description: Indicates whether this version supports Redis on Flash (Flex)

extraEnvVars.description: ADVANCED USAGE: use carefully. Add environment variables to RS StatefulSet's containers.

hostAliases.description: Adds hostAliases entries to the Redis Enterprise pods

activeActiveDatabases.description:
Exposes Active-Active databases via Gateway. REC-scoped only; per-database
overrides are not supported for Active-Active databases.

autoEnable.description:
Controls which Active-Active databases are Gateway-enabled by default:
None (default), All, or Selector (only those matching selector).

fqdnSuffix.description:
FQDN suffix for Active-Active endpoints; the per-database FQDN defaults to
<db-name>.<fqdnSuffix>.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Gateway. Defaults to the resource's namespace if omitted.

listenerName.description:
Gateway listener name; maps to the Route's parentRef.sectionName. If omitted,
the Gateway implementation selects a compatible listener.

listenerPort.description: Gateway listener port; maps to the Route's parentRef.port.

routeAnnotations.description:
Annotations for this endpoint's TLSRoute (e.g. for external-dns), merged over
gateway.default.routeAnnotations (these win on key conflicts).

routeLabels.description:
Labels for this endpoint's TLSRoute, merged over gateway.default.routeLabels
(these win on key conflicts). Operator-managed labels always take precedence.

selector.description: Label selector over Active-Active databases. Used only when autoEnable=Selector.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description:
A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that
relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description:
operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.
Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description:
values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn,
the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist,
the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic
merge patch.

matchLabels.description:
matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

set. Defaults: api.<fqdnSuffix>, ui.<fqdnSuffix>, metrics.<fqdnSuffix>,
<db-name>.db.<fqdnSuffix> (database), <db-name>.crdb.<fqdnSuffix> (Active-Active).

gatewayRef.description: Default Gateway referenced by endpoints that do not specify their own gatewayRef.

routeLabels.description:

routeLabels entry overrides the matching default key; operator-managed labels
always take precedence.

podAnnotations.description: annotations for the service rigger and redis enterprise pods

serviceNaming.description: Used to determine how to name the services created automatically when a database is created. When bdb_name is used, the database name will be also used for the service name. When redis-port is used, the service will be named redis-<port>.

podAnnotations.description: annotations for the service rigger pod

databaseServicePortPolicy.description: databaseServicePortPolicy instructs how to determine the service ports for REDB services. Defaults to DatabasePortForward, if not specified otherwise. Note - Regardless whether this flag is set or not, if an REDB/REAADB configured with databaseServicePort that would be the port exposed by the Service. DatabasePortForward - The service port will be the same as the database port. RedisDefaultPort - The service port will be the default Redis port (6379).
